full_prompt_en: A square expressionist oil painting isolates a compact stack of blunt pink-red blocks against a deep, nearly black background. The structure sits just below the center. A broad lower tier of several irregular rectangular forms spreads horizontally, supporting a smaller upper tier with a flat but uneven top. The blocks resemble worn masonry or compressed bundles, yet their exact material remains ambiguous. Dark maroon seams run between the units, while pale pink and chalky white scumbles catch the upper and front edges. A central notch on the upper tier breaks the otherwise heavy mass and reveals a darker red hollow. Stray reddish strokes and short drips hang from the front faces, making the surface feel worked over rather than smoothly rendered. The floor is a narrow expanse of gray-green and dusty mauve across the bottom quarter, with rough horizontal marks and a broad soft shadow beneath the stack. Behind it, the black field is spare and unmodulated, giving the pink form a stark, almost theatrical presence. Illumination appears to come from above and slightly left, lifting the top planes and letting crevices sink into dark red. The paint is thick and visibly handled: scraped passages, blunt strokes, and uneven edges all remain exposed. There is little depth beyond the floor plane, and the close, frontal viewpoint makes the object feel weighty and awkwardly monumental. Color is restricted to fleshy rose, brick red, wine-dark shadow, muddy gray, and black. The composition is still but uneasy, balancing a simple stacked silhouette with restless surface marks. It has the tactile directness of a painted study, allowing impasto, contour, and tonal contrast to carry the entire image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现主义油画把一堆敦实粉红色与红色方块孤立在深而近黑的背景前。结构位于中心稍下方。下层由几个不规则长方形横向铺开，托起较小的上层，其顶部平却不齐。这些方块似磨旧砖石或压实包块，但确切材质保持含混。深酒红色缝隙穿过各块之间，浅粉与粉笔白的擦痕攀上上缘和前缘。上层中央的一道缺口打断厚重团块，露出更深红的凹处。零散红色笔触与短短流挂留在正面，使表面看起来反复涂抹，而非平滑再现。地面是下方四分之一范围的一条灰绿与暗紫粉色带，带有粗糙水平色痕，堆块底下有宽而柔的影子。背后黑色区域空疏、几乎没有变化，使粉色形体显得突出且近乎舞台化。光似乎来自略偏左的上方，抬亮顶面，让缝隙沉入深红。颜料厚重，手工痕迹清楚：刮擦段落、钝重笔触和不平边缘全部暴露。地面之外几乎没有深度，近距离正面视角使物体显得沉重而笨拙地宏大。色彩限于肉粉、砖红、酒红深影、泥灰和黑色。构图静止却不安，以简洁堆叠剪影平衡躁动表面痕迹。它具有绘画习作的可触直接性，让厚涂、轮廓与明暗对比承载整幅图像。
style_prompt_en: Expressionist oil paint is applied in thick, blunt strokes and uneven scumbles. A compact stack of simple rectangular masses occupies a sparse dark field, its contour roughly defined rather than mechanically straight. Fleshy pink, brick red, and chalky white highlights sit over maroon crevices; muddy gray-green gives the low ground a shallow plane. Light from above selects upper facets while the deepest seams remain almost black. Scraped patches, short downward drips, and raised pigment make the surface insistently tactile. Broad negative space presses around the central form, heightening its isolated weight. The palette is narrow and the spatial depth slight, so impasto and the awkward rhythm of uneven edges become the main expressive forces.
style_prompt_zh: 表现主义油彩以厚实、钝重笔触和不均匀擦涂施加。简单长方团块紧凑堆在空疏深色域里，轮廓粗略而非机械笔直。肉粉、砖红和粉笔白亮部落在酒红缝隙上；泥灰绿让低处地面形成浅浅平面。上方光选中顶面小平面，最深的缝几乎全黑。刮擦斑块、短向下流挂及凸起颜料使表面特别可触。宽阔留黑空间挤压中央形体，增强其孤立的重量。色域狭窄、空间深度很浅，因此厚涂和不齐边缘的别扭节奏成为主要表现力量。
theme_en: A rough stack of pink rectangular blocks stands alone on a gray floor against black
theme_zh: 一堆粗糙粉红色长方块独立立于黑色背景前的灰地面上
name: Philip Guston
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
